verdict.rationale: Jules provides a first-party API, authenticated with API keys, for creating custom workflows and automating tasks such as bug fixing and code reviews. It also offers an optional automationMode for automatic PR creation and programmatic plan approval, so it can be driven without the web UI from scripts or pipelines. However, the evidence shows no CLI or documented CI/CD integration; headless pipeline use has to be assembled by the caller on top of raw API calls. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless command for shell scripts, documented CI/CD pipeline integration (e.g. a GitHub Actions recipe), and independent hands-on corroboration of running Jules inside CI.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run an agent headlessly inside CI/CD pipelines and shell scripts
